description: Completely or partially uninstall macOS applications — removing the app bundle plus all associated files (preferences, caches, logs, app support data, group containers, etc.). Use this skill whenever the user says anything like "uninstall X", "remove X app", "delete X application", "disinstall X", "get rid of X", "clean up X app", "wipe X", "remove all traces of X", or just "I want to delete an app". Also trigger when the user asks to "clean" an app (partial mode: keep the app, remove only caches/logs). If no app name is given, ask the user which app they want to remove. Always ask for confirmation before deleting anything.
